answer: Here is a specific defense: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by requiring post-paid stake that is forfeited on detection, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the bridge to sunk effort, uses the lagoon as an corroborating signal, then requires a terrace before any payout.
